name: Memory Acquisition
description: Ability to acquire volatile memory from live systems in a forensically sound manner. Covers RAM capture from physical and virtual machines using tools such as WinPmem, LiME, DumpIt, and hypervisor-based snapshot extraction. Includes understanding of acquisition artifacts, memory smear, and integrity considerations unique to volatile evidence.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to memory acquisition techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands why volatile memory is forensically valuable and the challenges of capturing it
evidence: Can explain what volatile memory contains and why it matters forensically
Understands the concept of memory smear and order of volatility
Can describe the difference between live acquisition and VM snapshot extraction

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Captures memory from standard systems under supervision using established tools and procedures
evidence: Captured RAM from Windows systems using DumpIt or WinPmem under guidance
Captured RAM from Linux systems using LiME under guidance
Extracted memory snapshots from VMware or Hyper-V virtual machines
Documented memory acquisition with hash values, timestamps, and system details

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently acquires memory from various system types with appropriate tool selection and full documentation
evidence: Independently acquired memory in 5+ investigations across Windows, Linux, and VM environments
Correctly selected acquisition tools based on OS, architecture, and deployment constraints
Acquisition documentation passes QA review consistently
Handled time-critical volatile evidence collection as part of live incident response

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Acquires memory from complex environments including hardened systems, cloud VMs, and embedded devices; mentors others on acquisition best practices
evidence: Acquired memory from systems with Secure Boot, HVCI, or kernel integrity protections
Performed memory acquisition from cloud VM instances via hypervisor API or agent-based methods
Handled acquisition from non-standard platforms (ARM-based, embedded, or containerised environments)
Reviews acquisition procedures and mentors junior staff on volatile evidence collection

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines memory acquisition methodology; validates tools against new platforms; researches acquisition challenges
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's memory acquisition procedures
Validated acquisition tool compatibility and reliability for new OS versions and architectures
Published research on memory acquisition techniques or tool reliability
Trains teams on memory acquisition and advises on volatile evidence strategy

assessment_methods.description: Acquire memory from a live Windows and Linux system using appropriate tools, document the process, and verify the capture
Observe memory acquisition during a live incident response or simulated exercise
